preconditions.description: The input must be a string.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789' for c in input_string)
preconditions.description: The input string must contain only uppercase letters and digits.
The input string must not be empty.

postconditions.description: The output must be the decimal sum of all valid hex words in the input string.
The sum of hex values must be non-negative.
